subject: accounting
objective: Break-even for an industrial-scale product line
instruction: A manufacturer of industrial equipment runs one high-volume line. Fixed costs for the year are 4800000 USD, the selling price is 1250 USD per machine and the variable cost per machine is 875 USD. Required: report the break-even quantity in machines, the contribution margin per machine, the contribution margin ratio, and the break-even revenue for the year.
